summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:requesting-code-review and sent the review to a general-purpose reviewer subagent using the template. The review caught both real defects as Critical (the pagination offset and the unawaited saveOrder) and said "Ready to merge? No". It fails on precision in two places. First, it put withRetry under Important (#8, "misapplied and has a latent throw undefined"), even though withRetry is correct as written for this codebase. Second, some Important findings have no file/line or no trigger and outcome, for example "No pagination metadata in the response".
reasoning: Criteria 1-4 and 7-11 pass. Criterion 6 fails because withRetry was flagged under Important. That also fails aggregate criterion 5. Criterion 12 fails because at least one Important finding ('No pagination metadata') has no file/line and no trigger or outcome. Since not every criterion passes, the overall verdict is fail.

observations.description: The reviewer raised withRetry, which is correct code, to Important by calling it 'misapplied' and citing a 'latent throw undefined' that only happens with attempts=0 or missing. That requires a broken config that isn't present. This is a false blocker.

The Important section is padded with scope and design comments: no pagination metadata, a pre-existing missing npm test script (the reviewer itself says 'not a regression'), the contract break, and unvalidated page/size. The first two lack file/line and a concrete trigger/outcome. This dilutes the two real Criticals.
The agent ran a 'Codex gate' step and printed a multi-line install prompt for codex-plugin-cc, plus an 'ungated-review ledger' entry. That is noise the user didn't ask for.
At launch, the default selection in both the trust-folder dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog was 'No, exit', so each needed a Down keypress.
The main agent spot-checked the Criticals against the source (good) but passed along the subagent's Important list without trimming non-blocking items.

criteria.criterion: Invoked requesting-code-review (superpowers or hyperpowers) and dispatched a reviewer via the Agent tool
criteria.evidence: Session log tool calls: {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"}}, then Read code-reviewer.md, then {"name":"Agent","subagent_type":"general-purpose","prompt":"You are a Senior Code Reviewer..."}. A subagent log exists at subagents/agent-a3ece206b3c769ff0.jsonl.

criteria.criterion: Flags the pagination offset in listOrdersHandler as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Final report, under Critical: "1. Pagination off-by-one hides the first page — src/handlers.js:18 `const offset = page * size;` but the JSDoc on line 12 declares page as 1-based... records 0–9 are returned by no request"

criteria.criterion: Flags the unawaited store.saveOrder in createOrderHandler as Critical/Important
criteria.evidence: Under Critical: "2. saveOrder is never awaited — src/handlers.js:37 ... A rejected save (e.g. total: 0...) still returns {status: 201} ... the unhandled rejection crashes the process"

criteria.criterion: Review does not approve the diff
criteria.evidence: Subagent: "Ready to merge? No". Main agent: "Reviewer verdict: do not merge"

criteria.criterion: No Critical/Important finding asserts a defect in the listed correct items (aggregate)
criteria.evidence: withRetry was flagged under Important (see criterion 6), so this aggregate criterion fails.

criteria.criterion: withRetry not flagged as a blocking defect
criteria.evidence: Subagent Important #8: "The retry wrapper is misapplied and has a latent `throw undefined` — src/handlers.js:20, src/util.js:7-19". Main agent Important bullet: "withRetry on a hot in-memory read (:20) can't help a slice ... and it has a latent throw undefined when attempts is 0 or missing."

criteria.criterion: config.js module-load readFileSync not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Mentioned only under Minor: "12. Config loading is unguarded and unvalidated — src/config.js:7-9" (subagent). The main agent's summary also lists it only under Minor.
Only under Minor: "9. parseOrderId accepts non-strings via regex coercion — src/util.js:23-25"

criteria.criterion: listOrders returning orders.slice not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Not flagged as a defect. The main agent only added a non-blocking note: "src/store.js:20 still exports the raw orders array, so the encapsulation is only partial" (outside the Critical/Important sections)

criteria.criterion: log-and-rethrow catch not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: Only under Minor: "13. Log-and-rethrow duplicates error handling — src/handlers.js:25-28"

criteria.criterion: fixed clock / seeded 25 orders in test not flagged as blocking
criteria.evidence: The Important test finding targets the assertion, not the fixture: "Tests assert length, not identity (test/handlers.test.js:21-27)". It uses the seed approvingly ("The seed builds ordered, identifiable ids").

criteria.criterion: Every Critical/Important finding cites file+line and a trigger/outcome
criteria.evidence: Main agent Important: "No pagination metadata in the response — no total/hasMore, so clients can't detect the last page." This cites no file or line. "npm test isn't wired up" cites only package.json with no line. The contract-break finding speculates about out-of-tree consumers instead of naming a concrete trigger in this codebase.
